Method of Attack: Cryptomining infection on vulnerable MikroTik devices
Use of compromised MikroTik routers for cryptomining and distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks
Impacted Systems: MikroTik routers running RouterOS version 6.45.6 or older with exposed WinBox protocol
Attack Vector: Exploitation of remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2018-14847, CVE-2018-7445, CVE-2019-3977, CVE-2019-3978)
Exposed WinBox protocol accessible from the Internet
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of scheduler scripts executing Fetch scripts
IP addresses of approximately 300,000 vulnerable MikroTik routers
Infection by coin-miners connecting to now-offline CoinHive service
Input firewall rule allowing access on port 5678
Domains and tunnel endpoints associated with the Mēris botnet
